Talent0_2Ability.name: Sophisticated Scientist
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: During an Active Attack in combat, inflict <buf ID=3006502>[Short Circuit I]</buf> on the target after combat, effective for <color=#F74848>1</color> time.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Sophisticated Scientist
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
During an Active Attack, inflict <buf ID=3006502>[Short Circuit I]</buf> on the hit target, effective <color=#F74848>1</color> time.
If the target's HP is full, DMG <color=#F74848>+15%</color>.

300001.name: Sniper Warfare 1
300001.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn. Unable to move before attacking.

300602.name: Instant Detonation
300602.SpecificEffects: During an Active Attack in combat, if the target has the <buf ID=900053>[Short Circuit]</buf> effect, trigger <buf ID=900053>[Short Circuit]</buf>'s Fixed DMG immediately after combat.

700013.name: Resolve
700013.SpecificEffects: When attacking a target that carries debuffs, DMG <color=#F74848>+15%</color>.

300605.name: Proficient
300605.SpecificEffects: At the end of the action, if a debuff was inflicted on <color=#F74848>3</color> targets during this turn, grant <buf ID=3006053>[Skilled]</buf> to self, effective <color=#F74848>2</color> times, lasting for <color=#F74848>1</color> turn.

300606.name: Puncture Shot
300606.describe: Uses Sniper Rifle to attack all targets within a <range type=1>Line (1*4 tiles) area in front</range>, dealing <color=#F74848>1x</color> AoE DMG.

700046.name: Duty
700046.SpecificEffects: When triggering <buf ID=900013>[Vigilant Shot]</buf>, DMG <color=#F74848>+15%</color> and Hit Rate <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.

300608.name: Great Creation
300608.describe: Uses Sniper Rifle to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.2x</color> DMG. Before combat, access <buf ID=900014>[Aiming]</buf> mode. If the target has the <buf ID=900053>[Short Circuit]</buf> effect, inflict <buf ID=900053>[Short Circuit]</buf> on enemies in the adjacent (<color=#F74848>1</color> tile) area after combat, dealing <buf ID=900017>[Fixed DMG]</buf> once, which is <color=#F74848>0.4x</color> DMG.

300011.name: Sniper Warfare 2
300011.SpecificEffects: After breaking a part, trigger <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>.

300021.name: Sniper Warfare 3
300021.SpecificEffects: Upon triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, allows movement of <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles before attacking.

300022.name: Power Innovation 2
300022.SpecificEffects: When breaking a part, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

300031.name: Forbidden Zone 1
300031.SpecificEffects: With a Ranged Weapon, launch <buf ID=900013>[Vigilant Shot]</buf> before the enemy attack within range, dealing <color=#F74848>0.35x</color> DMG, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

300034.name: Forbidden Zone 2
300034.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900013>[Vigilant Shot]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

300035.name: Forbidden Zone 3
300035.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900013>[Vigilant Shot]</buf>'s damage multiplier is increased to <color=#F74848>0.5</color>.

300036.name: Forbidden Zone 4
300036.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900013>[Vigilant Shot]</buf> is launched against an enemy that has not attacked. Targets the part with the lowest HP.

300641.name: Lust for Victory 1
300641.SpecificEffects: Any damage can inflict <buf ID=900053>[Short Circuit]</buf>.

300043.name: Power Innovation 3
300043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

300644.name: Lust for Victory 2
300644.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900053>[Short Circuit]</buf> will be effective for <color=#F74848>2</color> times.

300645.name: Lust for Victory 3
300645.SpecificEffects: The number of debuffs on the target will boost the Fixed DMG of <buf ID=900053>[Short Circuit]</buf> by 1% each, up to <color=#F74848>5%</color>.

300646.name: Lust for Victory 4
300646.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900053>[Short Circuit]</buf>'s Fixed DMG can break the part.
